ctx.x: You see Chris, Chris won trumpet. My brother Sam on planet. My brother E. F. was on bass. Little Jim on violin. I'm on guitar. And uh. Walter Arnold was playing drums. Oh I know Walter Arnold.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Your brother Sam, did he play saxophone much at all?

ctx.x: Dede must not be able to be in touch with him on the corner because he can't see so good you know. Oh no. No but I don't know if Miley Barnes knew him now.
Well I'll find him. Your brother Sam, did he play saxophone much at all?
Not much, not too much no.
